traps.title: The plan creation rate fell because the base changed
traps.explanation: Eligibility was expanded in week 5. Roughly 52,000 newly eligible customers a week started seeing the offer, and they convert at about 1.4%, versus about 4.5% for the original base. The blended rate fell even though the original base kept improving. Filter the dashboard to 'Originally eligible' to see it.

traps.title: The offer opt-out rate (a guardrail) more than doubled
traps.explanation: Newly eligible customers opt out of the offer at about 2.2%, versus 0.6% for the original base. A rising opt-out rate signals the offer is reaching people who do not want it, which can harm the customer relationship even while plan counts grow.
